summary: If a feeling has been buried for years, it may not come out politely once something finally forces it to the surface.
body: If a feeling has been buried for years, it may not come out politely once something finally forces it to the surface. When the Moon conjuncts Pluto, resentment, grief, fear, jealousy, or a private truth can change the emotional balance of a relationship in one conversation. Do not rush to make things comfortable again just because the honesty was intense. Figure out what the disclosure actually changes and what can no longer continue the way it did before.
